metadata.title: Einstein Constants and Smooth Topology, Revisited
metadata.abstract: In 1997, Catanese and the first author showed that, for every $m\geq 2$, there exists a smooth closed $4m$-manifold that admits both a $\lambda > 0$ Einstein metric and a $\lambda < 0$ Einstein metric; thus, the sign of the Einstein constant $\lambda$ is not always determined by the differential topology of the host compact manifold. This result was later improved by Răsdeaconu and Şuvaina (2009), who showed that there are in fact at least $\binom{m + 3}{3}$ topologically distinct such examples in each dimension $4m$, $m\geq 2$. In this note, we further improve these earlier results by showing that infinitely many topologically distinct examples of this phenomenon actually occur in dimension $4m$, for each $m\geq 2$.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.workSummary: 对每个 m≥2，作者构造无穷多个同伦型不同的闭单连通 4m 维流形，每个同时承载正、负 Einstein 常数的度量。定理B另给出各该维数的 spin 例子。构造从具有正 Einstein 度量的四维 toric 连通和 Mk 与负 Kähler–Einstein 复曲面 Xk 出发，二者 h-cobordant；对 m 重乘积使用高维 h-cobordism 定理得到微分同胚，再移植负 Einstein 乘积度量。
techniques: Li–Sun 的 toric Einstein 四维构件
Smale 高维 h-cobordism 与同常数乘积度量
analysis.breakthrough: 新 toric 四维构件突破有限复曲面配对的限制；乘积 Euler 特征无界，区分无穷多个同伦型。另以 spin 分支覆叠给出正负 Einstein 的 spin 例子。
analysis.limitations: 结论维度为4m≥8；四维构件仅 h-cobordant，不能直接声称四维同一光滑流形承载两种符号。核心新四维 Einstein 存在性为外部输入。已补读构造和主要证明，未独立核验所引用的存在定理。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。所查完整PDF文本及首尾页未见生成式AI协作披露。Claude 两处命中均为作者 Claude LeBrun 的姓名，不是AI工具声明；此结论不代表未使用AI。

analysis.priorityReason: 扩展 Einstein 常数符号与光滑拓扑关系的已知现象。
